You may add units to your Army List from the “Chaos Space

selectionEntries.comment: PHASE 0.1 ARSENAL PLACEHOLDER: this opt-in configuration is intentionally unchecked by default. The future Chaos Space Marine Arsenal reusable library must be linked with importRootEntries=false. World Eaters entry links to Arsenal units must be hidden until this exact configuration selection is present. No unresolved catalogue target is emitted here, so the native World Eaters catalogue remains loadable before the Arsenal library exists.

selectionEntries.comment:
FRESH INITIATES COST CONTRACT: when this exact KHORNE BERZERKERS instance is associated with BUTCHER SURGEON, its Phase 0.1 base Points cost is set to 0. Confirmed future behavior: every paid wargear/configuration cost belonging to this attached unit must also resolve to 0 while Fresh Initiates applies. Phase 0.1 has no paid Berzerker wargear nodes yet; when those enter scope, each descendant Points cost must use the same Butcher Surgeon association condition rather than charging separately.
LOADOUT UI: Berzerker Champion is the canonical Plasma Pistol model; Berzerker 2 is the canonical Eviscerator model; Berzerkers 3-5 carry the ordinary loadout. Free specialist replacements are represented directly rather than offering ordinary fallback states. Fresh Initiates also zeros the Icon of Khorne cost.

catalogue.comment:
PHASE 0.1 WORLD EATERS. Great Traitors’ Arsenal is implemented as an opt-in Configuration selection, unchecked by default. The external Chaos Space Marine Arsenal library is intentionally NOT represented by an unresolved catalogueLink in this file. When that reusable library is generated, add a catalogueLink with importRootEntries=false, then add World Eaters-local entryLinks for Arsenal units whose hidden state is controlled by the Great Traitors’ Arsenal configuration selection. Imported units should retain their normal Leader/Troop/Other categories and list-building constraints.
Fresh Initiates is mechanically implemented for the current Khorne Berzerkers base Points cost. Future paid wargear/configuration descendants on that attached host must also be set to 0 under the same Butcher Surgeon association condition.

COMPLETE LOADOUT + VARIABLE SIZE + ADDITIONAL COPY COST PASS
World Eaters now use Game System revision 11. Great Traitors’ Arsenal remains a placeholder. Chaos Lord Lightning Claws use the two-single-claw shorthand. Khorne Berzerkers and Jakhals use canonical specialist model identities. Red Butchers and Eightbound use optional third-model sizing. Eightbound Heavy Chain Glaive appears on every model and disappears from the others once selected. Fresh Initiates zeros both the Berzerker root cost and Icon of Khorne. All native non-Rare Other units use Additional Copy Costs.

CONSTRUCTIVE ERROR UX PASS
Mandatory Leader attachments, host attachment capacity, Rare limits, and Additional Copy Costs configuration safeguards now use the standardized constructive-error patterns. Great Traitors’ Arsenal remains a Phase 0.1 placeholder pending the reusable Chaos Space Marine Arsenal library. Glorious Jump Pack retains a temporary player-facing error because its required Raptors host is not yet available.
